english.title: Remain upon a vehicle on the Midland Metro after ticket ceased to be valid
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) remained upon a vehicle on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) when your

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(3) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
